name: bk_exp02_nonj
title: Of eight natural features, only the column count is cleanly outside the J-space
caption: A: J-space enrichment of each feature's class-mean direction at layer 42 (neuronpedia n1000 lens; J-space = top-r right singular vectors of W_U diag(1+w) J_42); filled = r*, open = 4r*; at or below 1.5 counts as J-depleted. Point estimates only (gates.json stores no CI for this statistic). The count passes, but the chat-frame version meant as an in-J calibration also stays out. B: r* is the smallest rank whose rebuilt lens keeps at least 90% top-10 agreement on 100 basic_readout items; values from RESULTS.md (no raw file locally), no CIs.
notes: Panel B: rstar.json is written by s8_rstar.py to the Modal results volume and is not in the repo; per brief, plotted from RESULTS.md text with no error bars. Only layer-42 agreement-by-rank is recorded in RESULTS (r* for other layers: 38: 192, 40: 384, 41: 384, 44: 256), so a per-layer curve could not be drawn.
